title: Map the current process and its pain points
summary: Before changing how an organisation works, understand how it works today, including the workarounds people rely on.

beginner: Pick the process to map and its start and end points.
Watch people do the work, not just what the procedure says.
Map each step, who does it, which systems they use and how long it takes.
Mark pain points, delays, rework and workarounds.
Check the map with the people who do the work.
intermediate: Observe and map the as-is process.
experienced: Map across departments to find hand-off problems.
Quantify the cost of pain points.
Use the map to build the case for change.

toolExamples.miro: Draw a swimlane map with a lane per role.
toolExamples.mural: Map the process with staff in a workshop.

pitfalls: Mapping the official process, not the real one
Skipping the people who do the work
